# Account Warmer

Account Warmer (9 pages): Account Warmer

## Chapters
- [Account Warmer](article_9124801244.md): The Account Warmer SuiteApp is designed to improve the first load experience in accounts that are rarely used.
  - [Account Warmer Overview](article_0209010010.md): The Account Warmer SuiteApp addresses a common issue in NetSuite's non-production accounts, such as Release Preview, Demo, Sandbox, and Next Preview accounts.
  - [Installing Account Warmer](article_0209011725.md): The Account Warmer SuiteApp can be installed from the SuiteApp Marketplace.
  - [Setting Up Account Warmer](article_0209012422.md): There is no further setup required to use the Account Warmer SuiteApp.
  - [Viewing the Account Warmer Details](article_0209012814.md): After setting up the Account Warmer, open the Account Warmer Portlet, or click the shortcut link and the Account Warmer details will appear.
  - [Account Warmer FAQ](article_0209013127.md): The following questions and answers could be helpful if you have a question.
